title: The Canton Hospital

groundCutout.basis: The reconstructed terrace covers the small area where the modern surface would obscure the historical arcade.

buildingCutout.basis: The 1895 exterior is registered inside the documented Renji Road hospital premises.

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified Copernicus DSM sampling beside the estimated historic courtyard, preserved for placement review.

mapIdentity.provider: Kerr’s 1880 Canton map and the named OpenStreetMap hospital site

identities.name: The Canton Hospital
identities.address: Historic Boji Hospital site, present North Campus at 107 Yanjiang West Road, Guangzhou, China

mapIdentity.scope: Mapped riverfront premises identify the site. Local placement and geographic heading are estimated inside the successor campus, using the current historic lane alignment and the nineteenth-century location. The 1895 photo fixes the visible building form and controls proportions.

note: The published 1895 photograph supports the exterior arcade, upper covered veranda, balustrade, tiled eaves and masonry details. Rear and side elevations continue the same building vocabulary where the image does not show them.
